name: How long does it take to complete interior doorway accessibility modifications?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete interior doorway accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for interior doorway accessibility modifications varies based on complexity and the number of doorways. Simple projects like installing offset hinges might take a few hours per door. Widening a non-load-bearing doorway might take 1-3 days per opening, including framing, drywall repair, and finishing. Load-bearing wall modifications could extend this timeline. City Dweller, LLC provides a project timeline in your proposal after assessing the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Modification time varies from hours for minor adjustments to several days per doorway for structural widening.
